programs.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
programs.desc: The world's greatest fortunes often surface in the most unlikely places. From a Fabergé egg found at a humble flea market, to rare baseball cards hidden inside an old piano, or even a backyard sapphire worth a king's ransom. These treasures prove that sometimes one person's forgotten clutter can become another's once-in-a-lifetime discovery.

programs.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
programs.desc: A long-lost keepsake tied to the world's most famous astronaut, a giant flying reptile that once ruled the skies, and a previously unknown planet orbiting two suns; some extraordinary discoveries remind us to keep looking up.

programs.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
programs.desc: Some discoveries defy explanation, like fossilized vomit from the Jurassic era, a sewer blob with a pulse, even a long-lost toy discovered inside a man's lung. These freaky finds prove that reality can be stranger-and far creepier-than fiction.

programs.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
programs.desc: From a $4 flea market frame concealing the Declaration of Independence, or a lost Fabergé egg in a Midwest flea market and even the holy grail of comic books hiding in someone's wall, we revisit the most astonishing, valuable discoveries.

programs.title: The Proof Is Out There: Alien Edition
programs.desc: A strange sphere hovers silently above a house in Nevada. Two bright orbs appear to follow a rocket launch at Cape Canaveral. Are extraterrestrials secretly watching us? Tony Harris and his team analyze the evidence to determine whether something from beyond is monitoring humanity.

programs.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
programs.desc: Some discoveries come with consequences; gold that ruins lives, a cursed wreck beneath the sea, and a hidden safe linked to a famous burglar, show how the past can be as dangerous as it is tempting.
